text:
alex: deploybot blocked the release: build:verify step failing checksum on server bundle. holding promotion.

deploy-bot: [automatic] release/2026.03.26 build:verify failed (artifact checksum mismatch). logs: https://ci.internal/1726001234 

maria: which runner? any pattern?
alex: failed on us-runner-4 during assemble-bundles. snippet: 
```
VERIFY: bundle-server.tgz
expected sha256: 12ab34cd56ef...
actual   sha256: 12ab34cd56ee...
STATUS: MISMATCH
```

devon: hmm similar to last week's multipart reassembly issue on s3-mpu-02. could be part reordering on reassemble.
ops-oncall: we have 28m left in change window. rerun takes ~18m avg. If rerun passes we can still promote but tight.
maria: teams are waiting on release notes and a docs push. If rerun fails again we should pin to last-known-good.
alex: last-good digest: bundle-server.tgz@sha256:ff99aa88 verified at 1725960000. I can pin now if we agree.
devon: plan options: (A) rerun now -> risk miss window; (B) pin and do small canary -> unblocks change window. I prefer B with tight monitoring.
ops-oncall: agree with B. Canary 5% for 10m, alert on 5xx or error rate delta >0.3%.
maria: add callout in release notes: "Pinned server bundle due to CI artifact checksum mismatch; full re-run and investigation scheduled post-release (ENG-4950)."
alex: executing pin & canary: 
```
deploybot pin --release release/2026.03.26 --component server --digest ff99aa88
deploybot promote --release release/2026.03.26 --mode canary --percent 5
```

deploy-bot: [automatic] pinned server to ff99aa88; canary started 5% at 1726001298.
ops-oncall: watching dashboards; no anomalies in first 3m. will escalate if any spike.
maria: updating release notes and pinging #customer-facing.
devon: creating ENG-4950 with runner id us-runner-4 and s3-mpu-02 details.
alex: canary held for 12m, healthy; promoting to 100% now. promote command executed at 1726001538.
deploy-bot: [automatic] promote completed to 100% at 1726001540. release cut unblocked.
ops-oncall: follow-up: schedule rerun outside change window and attach full logs to ENG-4950.
maria: ack. closing thread.
